financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of 1,000 shares of Series 2022 Convertible Preferred Stock at $0.27 per share
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On May 9, 2022, the Company designated a new class of convertible stock and sold 1,000 shares of the new class of convertible preferred stock.

warrants.quote: the Company issued to Bryan Capital a Warrant to purchase 1,289,581 shares of the Common Stock at an exercise price of $1.33 per share. The Warrant expires October 10, 2026
